KeyStarButton Mapper

Buttons, reimagined.

Map your Android device's buttons to the things you do every day. Control music, open apps, run Tasker tasks, and build shortcuts that change with the app you're using.

FeaturesCompatibilityScreenshotsSupport
Google PlayDirect Download

Features

01

Ten ways to press

Single through quintuple presses, plus a long-press version of each.

02

Shortcuts for each app

Use contexts to give the same button different actions in individual apps and on the lock screen.

03

Dozens of built-in actions

Open apps, manage media playback, change system settings, launch digital assistants, perform system actions, and more.

04

Customised actions

Create your own touch sequences, run custom Tasker tasks, or invoke Android intents.

05

Keep familiar controls

Exclude apps such as Camera and Clock so their volume-button controls continue to work normally.

06

Fine-tune everything

Adjust standard and long press delays, haptic feedback, volume adjustment speed, and more.

Compatibility

KeyStar compatibility and license requirements
AndroidAndroid 8 or later. Available features can vary by Android version.
HardwareIf it runs Android, it will run KeyStar.
PermissionsNotifications and Read Logs are required. Other permissions are optional and requested when using specific features.
LicenseVolume button mapping is free. Power and navigation button mapping require a one-time purchase.
